title: Minimise surveillance data and make identity linkage conditional
requirements:
- Replace universal LHR integration and verified-identity linkage with conditions set by national architecture and use case
- Require purpose limitation, legal authority, minimisation and sensitivity classification
- Replace a universal case dataset with a cross-hazard core and condition-specific modules
- Require identity-optional case creation, pseudonymous identifiers and later reconciliation
- Require human-rights safeguards against stigma and repurposing
- Limit geographic detail by purpose and population size
- Limit LHR and workforce data access to bounded, legally authorised surveillance datasets
- Time-limit emergency powers and data reuse
